We need a pedestal boundary that can run inside the differentiable transport
loop. The [Primer](../primer.qmd) explains why the boundary and core evolve
together; terminology is in the [Glossary](../glossary.qmd).

The owner has selected an electron-cyclotron (EC) heating and current-drive reference and a pretrained
pressure/width pedestal model for ITER. EC labelling and the ITER port can proceed
independently. MAST-U keeps its prescribed pedestal, with predictive closure deferred;
ion-cyclotron work is deferred too.

We ported the selected pedestal model to JAX. Its loader checks the exact
checkpoint digest and reads numeric data without executing Julia objects. Loaded
inference uses JAX only. The port preserves the model's preprocessing, neural layers,
power-law correction and pressure/width outputs. All pedestal solutions remain available;
no boundary branch is selected implicitly.

The port reproduces the pinned upstream regression values: [12 upstream scalar regression values agree within relative tolerance 1e-12]{.claim}[C-149](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-149){.cid .st-measured}.
Focused domain, solution-selection, compilation, batch and derivative checks pass in
both modes: [12 focused tests pass in full and Tier-A-only modes]{.claim}[C-150](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-150){.cid .st-tested}. Derivative comparisons use an interior numerical fixture
and keep its domain mask unchanged. The upstream regression values are the reference;
the Julia runtime itself was not executed. These are implementation checks, with
no independent physicist review of the coupled boundary.

This is a numerical port of a trained model. It does not establish agreement with full
EPED or with a coupled physical trajectory. The selected single network provides no
ensemble spread, so no uncertainty estimate is inferred from it.

Coupled ITER integration still needs the pedestal solution, supplied density and
composition, temperature partition, and conversion from the model's poloidal-flux width
to the transport boundary. The EC reference source is staged separately. Its baseline
launch and current-drive prescription remain to be selected, and its current channel
needs an adapter into TORAX. No EC labels or new coupled runtime result are claimed.

M3 remains in progress. Later entries record the EC reference's build and
[completed numerical pilot](34-genray-corrected-numerical-pilot.qmd).
